selection_rule: Compare development evidence_recall@5; test is report-only, not a tuning set.
v3_validation_note: Measured on the unchanged legacy PDF corpus during v3 implementation; not a GigaChat, OCR, uploaded-corpus or end-to-end answer evaluation. The generic provenance includes unused LLM defaults; no LLM was called.
limitations: A small authored retrieval set over two bundled reports; no claim of broad domain generalization.
Legacy word-based chunks remain unchanged, including model truncation behavior.
Clean query is an authored query variant, not an agent-generated query evaluation.
Full-question and held-out-test results must also be reported.
Fixed managed-corpus evaluation is now executable, but no manually labeled uploaded-document quality dataset is supplied.
